# Uniapp-AIKIT documentation

> Documentation for AIKO Agent Kit, a uni-app Vue 3 frontend component library. Source code is distributed through DCloud Marketplace.

- [Marketplace](https://ext.dcloud.net.cn/plugin?id=28709)
- [Interactive preview](https://uniapp-aikit.pages.dev/)
- [Vibe Coding contract](./VIBE_CODING.md)
- [Component manifest](./component-manifest.json): paths refer to the installed uni_modules/aiko-ai-elements plugin.
- [Component guide](./components/README.md)
- [Compatibility](./COMPATIBILITY.md)
- [Validation](./VALIDATION.md)

Read installed component types before generating props. Do not guess source paths in this documentation-only repository.
